priority_research.label: Priority research
priority_research.description: Strong demand, approachable competition, stable pricing and high confidence. Validate brand permission and sourcing next.

promising.label: Promising
promising.description: Good market evidence with slightly broader thresholds for manual investigation.

low_competition.label: Low seller competition
low_competition.description: Few current offers and a high competition score. This does not measure competing substitute products.

stable_pricing.label: Stable pricing
stable_pricing.description: High price-stability score with sufficient evidence and a current Buy Box price.

needs_evidence.label: Needs evidence
needs_evidence.description: Low-confidence products that should not move to sourcing decisions yet.

all.label: All products
all.description: The complete imported product universe with no research-policy threshold applied.
